# Prismatic

> Prismatic is the embedded iPaaS (integration platform as a service) purpose-built for B2B SaaS companies. It lets product and engineering teams build, deploy, and manage customer-facing integrations faster, using low-code or code-native tooling, an embedded integration marketplace, and AI-assisted integration building.

The most detailed, LLM-optimized content lives in the documentation. For full product, API, and connector guidance, fetch https://prismatic.io/docs/llms.txt.

## Documentation
- [Documentation home](https://prismatic.io/docs/): Full product, API, and connector documentation.
- [LLM-optimized docs index](https://prismatic.io/docs/llms.txt): Complete, structured docs map for AI assistants and coding agents.

## Product & platform
- [Platform overview](https://prismatic.io/platform/): How the Prismatic platform works end to end.
- [Low-code integration designer](https://prismatic.io/platform/low-code-integration-designer/): Visually build integrations.
- [Code-native integrations](https://prismatic.io/platform/code-native-integrations/): Build integrations in TypeScript.
- [Embedded workflow builder](https://prismatic.io/platform/embedded-workflow-builder/): Let customers build workflows inside your app.
- [AI for integrations](https://prismatic.io/platform/ai-for-integrations/): AI-assisted and agentic integration building.
- [Monitoring & management tools](https://prismatic.io/platform/monitoring-management-tools/): Operate and support integrations at scale.
